# eloquent-ddl-sqlite

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities mapped with Eloquent 12, repositories and services, in PHP 8.4. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: sqlite.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return the entities; updates take a Patch per field: absent, or a value that may be null.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/Database.php             the connection of DATABASE_URL, which the models use
src/UnitOfWork.php           the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/Errors/                  NotFoundException, ConflictException, ValidationFailedException: no HTTP codes
src/Entities/                one entity per table
src/Repositories/            the repositories of each table
src/Services/                one service per table
tests/                       repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json           what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
composer install
vendor/bin/phpunit                                    # SQLite in memory
TEST_DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///app.db" vendor/bin/phpunit   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

namespace App\Common;

/**
 * A page of a list: the rows from an offset, and how many there are in all.
 *
 * @template T
 */
final readonly class Page
{
    /** @param list<T> $items */
    public function __construct(public array $items, public int $total, public int $offset, public int $limit)
    {
    }

    /**
     * The same page with every row turned into something else.
     *
     * @template R
     * @param callable(T): R $mapper
     * @return Page<R>
     */
    public function map(callable $mapper): self
    {
        return new self(array_map($mapper, $this->items), $this->total, $this->offset, $this->limit);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Common;

/**
 * A field of an update: absent (it keeps its value), or present with a value, which may be null.
 *
 * @template T
 */
final readonly class Patch
{
    /** An absent field; use Patch::of() for one with a value. */
    public function __construct(public bool $isPresent = false, public mixed $value = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * The field keeps its value.
     *
     * @return Patch<mixed>
     */
    public static function absent(): self
    {
        return new self();
    }

    /**
     * The field takes this value, which may be null.
     *
     * @template V
     * @param V $value
     * @return Patch<V>
     */
    public static function of(mixed $value): self
    {
        return new self(true, $value);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use Illuminate\Database\Capsule\Manager;
use Illuminate\Database\Connection;

/** The database DATABASE_URL names, through Eloquent. It never migrates: the database already exists. */
final class Database
{
    public const DEFAULT_URL = 'sqlite:///app.db';

    /** The URL of DATABASE_URL, or the default one. */
    public static function url(): string
    {
        $url = getenv('DATABASE_URL');
        return is_string($url) && $url !== '' ? $url : self::DEFAULT_URL;
    }

    /** A connection to the database at $url (DATABASE_URL when null); the models use it from then on. */
    public static function open(?string $url = null): Connection
    {
        $capsule = new Manager();
        $capsule->addConnection(self::config($url ?? self::url()));
        $capsule->bootEloquent();
        return $capsule->getConnection();
    }

    /**
     * The settings of the connection to a URL: postgresql://, mysql://, mariadb:// or sqlite:///<path> (sqlite:///:memory: for one in memory).
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function config(string $url): array
    {
        if (str_starts_with($url, 'sqlite:')) {
            $path = substr($url, strlen('sqlite:///'));
            return ['driver' => 'sqlite', 'database' => $path !== '' ? $path : ':memory:', 'foreign_key_constraints' => true];
        }
        return ['url' => $url];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Repositories;

use App\Common\Page;
use App\Entities\AuditEntry;

/** Keeps audit_entries rows in memory, for tests and for trying the services without a database. */
final class MemoryAuditEntryRepository implements AuditEntryRepository
{
    /** @var array<string, AuditEntry> */
    private array $rows = [];

    private int $nextId = 1;

    /**
     * The key of a row, as a list of its key values.
     *
     * @return list<mixed>
     */
    private static function keyOf(AuditEntry $row): array
    {
        return [$row->entry_no];
    }

    private static function keyText(AuditEntry $row): string
    {
        return serialize(array_map(fn (mixed $value) => $value instanceof \DateTimeInterface ? $value->format('Y-m-d H:i:s.u P') : $value, self::keyOf($row)));
    }

    /**
     * The rows reads can see, by primary key.
     *
     * @return list<AuditEntry>
     */
    private function visible(): array
    {
        $rows = array_values(array_filter($this->rows, fn (AuditEntry $row) => true));
        usort($rows, fn (AuditEntry $a, AuditEntry $b) => self::keyOf($a) <=> self::keyOf($b));
        return $rows;
    }

    public function findByEntryNo(int $entryNo): ?AuditEntry
    {
        foreach ($this->visible() as $row) {
            if ($row->entry_no == $entryNo) {
                return $row;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function list(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        $rows = $this->visible();
        return new Page(array_slice($rows, $offset, $limit), count($rows), $offset, $limit);
    }

    public function listByOrderId(int $orderId): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter($this->visible(), fn (AuditEntry $row) => $row->orderId == $orderId));
    }

    public function insert(AuditEntry $entity): AuditEntry
    {
        if ($entity->entry_no === null) {
            $entity->entry_no = $this->nextId++;
        }
        $this->rows[self::keyText($entity)] = $entity;
        return $entity;
    }

    public function update(AuditEntry $entity): AuditEntry
    {
        $this->rows[self::keyText($entity)] = $entity;
        return $entity;
    }

    public function delete(AuditEntry $entity): void
    {
        unset($this->rows[self::keyText($entity)]);
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services;

use App\Common\Page;
use App\Entities\AuditEntry;
use App\Errors\FieldError;
use App\Errors\NotFoundException;
use App\Errors\ValidationFailedException;
use App\UnitOfWork;

/** Operations on audit_entries. Each write runs in its own transaction. */
final class AuditEntryService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly UnitOfWork $uow)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Checks the values against the rules of the "audit_entries" table, and the rows they point to; throws ValidationFailedException with every problem.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function validate(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?AuditEntry $current): void
    {
        $creating = $current === null;
        $errors = [];
        $value = $values['orderId'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('orderId', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('orderId', 'is required');
            }
        }
        $value = $values['message'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('message', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('message', 'is required');
            }
        } else {
            if (is_string($value) && mb_strlen($value) > 200) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('message', 'is longer than 200 characters');
            }
        }
        $orderId = array_key_exists('orderId', $values) ? $values['orderId'] : $current?->orderId;
        if ($orderId !== null && $uow->order->findById($orderId) === null) {
            $errors[] = new FieldError('orderId', 'no Order has this key');
        }
        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException('AuditEntry', $errors);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Every check before a write: the values, the rows they point to, the unique values.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function check(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?AuditEntry $current): void
    {
        self::validate($uow, $values, $current);
    }

    /**
     * Sets the given values on the entity.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function apply(AuditEntry $entity, array $values): void
    {
        if (array_key_exists('orderId', $values)) {
            $entity->orderId = $values['orderId'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('message', $values)) {
            $entity->message = $values['message'];
        }
    }

    /** The AuditEntry with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    private static function find(UnitOfWork $uow, int $entryNo): AuditEntry
    {
        return $uow->auditEntries->findByEntryNo($entryNo) ?? throw new NotFoundException('AuditEntry', $entryNo);
    }

    /**
     * The values an update gives, by field.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function given(AuditEntryChanges $changes): array
    {
        $values = [];
        if ($changes->orderId->isPresent) {
            $values['orderId'] = $changes->orderId->value;
        }
        if ($changes->message->isPresent) {
            $values['message'] = $changes->message->value;
        }
        return $values;
    }

    /** Stores a new AuditEntry after checking it. */
    public function createAuditEntry(AuditEntry $auditEntry): AuditEntry
    {
        $values = array_filter([
            'orderId' => $auditEntry->orderId,
            'message' => $auditEntry->message,
        ], fn (mixed $value) => $value !== null);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($values, $auditEntry): AuditEntry {
            self::check($uow, $values, null);
            return $uow->auditEntries->insert($auditEntry);
        });
    }

    /** The AuditEntry with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    public function getAuditEntry(int $entryNo): AuditEntry
    {
        return self::find($this->uow, $entryNo);
    }

    /**
     * A page of audit_entries, by primary key.
     *
     * @return Page<AuditEntry>
     */
    public function listAuditEntries(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        return $this->uow->auditEntries->list($offset, $limit);
    }

    /** Changes the given values of a AuditEntry. */
    public function updateAuditEntry(int $entryNo, AuditEntryChanges $changes): AuditEntry
    {
        $values = self::given($changes);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($entryNo, $values): AuditEntry {
            $current = self::find($uow, $entryNo);
            self::check($uow, $values, $current);
            self::apply($current, $values);
            return $uow->auditEntries->update($current);
        });
    }

    /** Deletes a AuditEntry. */
    public function deleteAuditEntry(int $entryNo): void
    {
        $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($entryNo): void {
            $current = self::find($uow, $entryNo);
            $uow->auditEntries->delete($current);
        });
    }

    /**
     * The audit_entries with this orderId.
     *
     * @return list<AuditEntry>

    }

    {

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests;

use App\Database;
use App\SqlUnitOfWork;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Builder;

/** The test database: TEST_DATABASE_URL, or SQLite in memory, with every table created empty for every test. */
final class TestDatabase
{
    public static function url(): ?string
    {
        $url = getenv('TEST_DATABASE_URL');
        return is_string($url) && $url !== '' ? $url : null;
    }

    /** The repositories over the test database, with every table dropped and created again. */
    public static function open(): SqlUnitOfWork
    {
        $db = Database::open(self::url() ?? 'sqlite:///:memory:');
        $schema = $db->getSchemaBuilder();
        $schema->dropAllTables();
        self::createTables($schema);
        return new SqlUnitOfWork($db);
    }

    /** Every table as the database has it, parents first. */
    private static function createTables(Builder $schema): void
    {
        $schema->create('things', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->bigInteger('id', true);
            $table->smallInteger('small');
            $table->bigInteger('big');
            $table->decimal('price', 10, 2);
            $table->double('d');
            $table->boolean('flag')->default(true);
            $table->date('born');
            $table->time('opens');
            $table->dateTime('at');
            $table->dateTime('changed')->nullable()->useCurrent();
            $table->binary('bin');
            $table->json('data')->nullable();
            $table->char('code', 5);
            $table->text('note')->nullable();
            $table->decimal('total', 12, 2)->nullable()->storedAs('price * 2');
        });

        $schema->create('kinds', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->string('code', 10);
            $table->date('day');
            $table->string('label', 30)->nullable();
            $table->primary(['code', 'day']);
        });

        $schema->create('Order', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->bigInteger('Id', true);
            $table->string('user', 40);
            $table->bigInteger('group')->default(0);
            $table->string('customerName', 60);
            $table->text('class')->nullable();
            $table->text('metadata')->nullable();
            $table->date('date')->nullable();
            $table->time('time')->nullable();
            $table->string('text', 20)->nullable();
            $table->text('list')->nullable();
            $table->string('str', 10)->nullable();
            $table->bigInteger('int')->nullable();
            $table->date('dueDate');
            $table->time('closesAt')->nullable();
            $table->dateTime('createdAt')->nullable()->useCurrent();
            $table->string('kind_code', 10)->nullable();
            $table->date('kind_day')->nullable();
            $table->bigInteger('thing_id')->nullable();
            $table->bigInteger('parentId')->nullable();
            $table->unique(['customerName']);
            $table->foreign(['thing_id'])->references(['id'])->on('things')->onDelete('set null');
            $table->foreign(['parentId'])->references(['Id'])->on('Order');
            $table->foreign(['kind_code', 'kind_day'])->references(['code', 'day'])->on('kinds');
            // CHECK ("group" >= 0): the schema builder has no CHECK constraints
        });

        $schema->create('audit_entries', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->bigInteger('entry_no', true);
            $table->bigInteger('orderId');
            $table->string('message', 200);
            $table->foreign(['orderId'])->references(['Id'])->on('Order')->onDelete('cascade');
        });

        $schema->create('empties', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->bigInteger('id', true);
            $table->text('note')->nullable();
        });
    }
}
